checks: Private conversation IDs/URLs and local source paths
Capture epochs and dated capture filenames
Source-specific absolute-odometer ranges and raw odometer byte examples; workbook/map review
manual_review: Current year-specific docs and confidence boundaries
Historical warning banners and workbook current-qualification columns
Odometer slots withheld in the80-byte historical mask table
No original payload/trip-grid/media/private source archive included
Publication made from a new clean directory, without Git history
Stationary reference pairs use relative time only
excluded: Original full-CAN and focused source logs
Original photographs, video, audio and workbook binary
Private input hashes, identities, capture clocks and absolute odometers
Private build scripts and compiled Python bytecode
limitations: Distinctive research and vehicle pairing may be recognizable
The publishing account and future commit metadata can identify authorship
Previously shared copies and future additions are outside this review
scope: Privacy-reduced technical publication. This is not a claim that every original source can be redistributed or that removed information is irrecoverable elsewhere.

repository_completion_review.scope: Supplement to the original 83-file source-aware review: current release files checked for known local paths, attachment identifiers, credential patterns, binary content and excluded file types. New tests contain only synthetic frames; no private original inputs were available for a new source-specific scan.
repository_completion_review.commit_identity: Project display name and GitHub no-reply email. Hosting account and no-reply address remain identifying metadata.
repository_completion_review.original_review: The original review above is retained as imported evidence; it does not cover future changes.

public_readiness_review.commit_metadata: Project display name and owner GitHub no-reply email; no private personal email or local path found.
public_readiness_review.release_scope: Original v0.1.0 tag and asset bytes retained; current main receives public-publication notices and an updated manifest.
public_readiness_review.distribution: Public visibility authorized by maintainer. No reuse license applied; scientific limitations and private-source exclusions retained.
public_readiness_review.limitations: Known-pattern checks of history and logs supplement document review; they cannot detect all secrets or guarantee anonymity. Original private sources were unavailable for a new source-specific comparison.

discovery_materials_review.source: Native SVG design rendered locally. The only payload is the documented synthetic decoder example, not captured vehicle data.
discovery_materials_review.image_exclusion: Only the exact generated PNG path is allowlisted. Raw vehicle images and recordings remain excluded.
discovery_materials_review.announcement_scope: The initial r/CarHacking announcement requests independent validation, retains sample and license limits, and asks for anonymous summaries. Only the generated synthetic graphic was attached.
discovery_materials_review.social_preview_setting: Installed and verified in GitHub settings and through usesCustomOpenGraphImage=true.
